title: Surface the existing Pulse fare estimate in the working same-day QR booking lane
target: Existing live same-day QR booking form using the merged PULSE-059 fare engine
acceptanceCriteria: Do not rebuild or replace the working QR form, NOW/LATER selector, Inbox, request hold, lifecycle, or request writer.
The same-day QR rider sees a Pulse fare after pickup, destination, and same-day pickup time are available and before confirming the request.
Fare calculation reuses pulseGetFareQuote from PULSE-059 and does not create a Ride Requests row, email, Calendar event, or trip.
Changing pickup, destination, date, or time invalidates the prior quote and requires recalculation.
The rider cannot submit through the fare-enabled flow with an expired or missing quote.
The existing standalone request app remains the only Ride Requests writer.
The existing QR lane remains same-day only; future-date scheduling remains on the separate rider form and is not changed by this task.
No competitor fare, payment, automatic dispatch, production deployment, production mutation, or engine activation is introduced.
Pulse Forge CI passes before merge.
